name: Wind Bind
body:
School evocation [air]; Level druid 2, ranger 2, shaman 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Calling out to the elemental forces of air you grasp at and bind a foe. When you cast this spell your target must make a Reflex saving throw or be entangled by air and suspended up to 10 feet above the ground.

While entangled in this way the target must make concentration checks to cast spells with a DC equal to this spells save DC + the level of the spell being cast, in addition any sounds the creature makes are drowned out by the binding winds and cannot be heard by others.
